topic: Day 45 — carousel — You can't ask for trust while withholding the information to earn it

slides.text: Trust needs enough transparency to make an informed choice.
Trust and blind faith get conflated constantly.
Real trust needs enough visibility to assess the risk.

caption:
Trust requires enough transparency for the other person to make an informed choice. Asking for blind trust is asking for something else.

Follow for one of these a day.
